messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Welcome, fellow member of the Campfire Cult. It is time to embrace the Campfire within and sacrifice something. What that something should be is an interesting question. I am thinking potato. Yes. Yes, a good baked potato does sound very good right now.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 欢迎,篝火教团的同伴。是时候拥抱内心的篝火并献祭些什么了。该献祭什么是个有趣的问题。我想是土豆。对。对,一颗好烤土豆现在听起来确实很不错。

messages.text: Come, my brethren, and let us rejoice!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 来吧,我的兄弟姐妹们,让我们欢庆吧!
